title: queltia orientalis
intro: Queltia orientalis, commonly known as Oriental Queltia, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Asparagaceae family. It is known for its numerous health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Queltia orientalis include its ability to act as an adaptogen, helping the body to adapt to stress and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Queltia orientalis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
